description:
Automatically reads new output in Command Prompt, PowerShell, and Windows Terminal in real-time. Features instant audio notifications for terminal states and errors, customizable error keywords, a dedicated NVDA settings panel for privacy management, and live session shadow history scrolling without disrupting your workflow.
Hot Keys:
CTRLALT+L : Open CMDReader File
ctrl+alt+up arrow : Read the previous line
ctrl+alt+down arrow : Read the next line
changelog: Refactored architecture: Decoupled logic from __init__.py into `cmdCore.py` for modular standard compliance. Expanded NVDA Settings Panel: Users can now fully customize addon behavior directly from NVDA preferences. Added 'Strict Privacy Mode' option to instantly disable all disk logging for highly sensitive console sessions. Unhardcoded error phrases: Custom error keywords can now be added or modified freely via settings (comma-separated). Added global Sound Toggle: Users can now optionally silence Window Ready, Command Finished, and Command Error beeps. Completely removed `cmdreader_history.json` and migrated terminal history to an absolute in-memory state with aggressive cleanup functionality.
